Zoo Toss Rules

Roll animal dice and fill the card with the animals it shows. Whoever wins four cards first wins the game.

The rules

The goal
Every card shows three to five animals. When you have rolled all of them, the card is yours. Whoever has four cards first wins. The game has 30 cards; at the start of every round two of them lie open.
Choosing a card
The first player of a round taps one of the two open cards. A card with many different animals is easier to fill: several dice can hit at once. A card that needs the same animal two or three times asks for more luck.
Your turn
Roll as many dice as the card still needs. Every die that shows an animal of the card goes onto the card and stays there, marked with a tick. Roll the other dice again. You may roll up to three times.
The paw
The sixth side of the dice shows a paw. It is a joker: it counts as the animal that the card still needs most.
Not full yet
If the card is not full after three rolls, the dice stay on it. The next player continues with the animals that are still missing and may win the card.
The end
When a card is full, the player takes it and the next player starts a new round. The game ends at once when someone has four cards. With two to four players a game takes about five minutes. There is no time limit, and nothing has to be read: every card and every die shows pictures.

Example

The card shows three lions and a monkey. You roll four dice: lion, penguin, paw, giraffe. The lion goes onto the card and the paw becomes a second lion. Two dice are left, for a lion and the monkey: roll them again, up to two more times.
